title: Route BitMatrix::mul row-XOR through xor_fn dispatch
description:
Route `BitMatrix::mul` non-M4RM row-XOR fallback through the existing AVX2 XOR dispatch.

## Background

`BitMatrix::mul` normally uses the M4RM implementation in `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/m4rm.rs`. When `choose_k_block(k, n)` degenerates to `1`, M4RM table precomputation has no reuse advantage; that path is now routed to a direct row-XOR fallback, `BitMatrix::mul_row_xor_dispatch`, which computes each output row as the XOR of rows of `rhs` selected by set bits in the corresponding row of `lhs`.

The fallback resolves `crate::kernels::ops::resolve_xor_inplace` once before the row loop. For output rows with width >= 8 u64 words, the resolved function pointer routes through the existing `LogicalFns::xor_fn` AVX2 dispatch. No new unsafe code is added to `gf2-core`, and `choose_k_block` / the normal M4RM crossover remain unchanged.

## Lead review history

R0 was rejected before merge because it benchmarked `matmul_square/1024` and `/2048`; those shapes use M4RM with `k_block=8`, so they measured the prior `c69d2055` M4RM row-XOR dispatch rather than this issue's non-M4RM fallback. The user approved rework to add/route a benchmark that actually exercises the fallback and gate performance on that path.

R1 adds the dedicated Criterion leaf `matmul_row_xor_fallback/{scalar_backend,dispatch_helper,production_mul}/512x1x8192`:

- `lhs` shape is 512x1 and `rhs` shape is 1x8192.
- `choose_k_block(k=1, n=8192)` must return 1 because the selector cannot choose a block size greater than `k`.
- `alg::m4rm::multiply` therefore branches to `BitMatrix::mul_row_xor_dispatch`.
- `rhs.cols = 8192`, so output rows are 128 u64 words, above the 8-word SIMD dispatch threshold.

The `criterion-1.5x` A2 comparator was amended to compare the current scalar fallback leaf (`matmul_row_xor_fallback/scalar_backend`) against the current dispatched production fallback leaf (`matmul_row_xor_fallback/production_mul`). This current-leaf mode is used only for benchmark leaves created after the pinned V0 baseline commit.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Existing matmul tests + word-boundary `#[test]`s pass at n in {0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 127, 128, 129}.
- [hard] Proptest equivalence vs. scalar via the I4 helper.
- [hard] M4RM path crossover unchanged: `choose_k_block` logic is unchanged and square 1024/2048 remain on M4RM (`k_block=8`).
- [hard] Sibling `*.asm.txt` artefact shows the dispatched fallback call site and vector XOR in `LogicalFns::xor_fn`; on this toolchain the full-vector XOR mnemonic for that function is `vxorps`, which is the inspected 256-bit register XOR for the fallback call site.
- [hard] `perf stat -r 10` capture before/after recorded in this JIT issue.
- [aspirational] >= 1.5x geomean over the scalar fallback comparator at the non-M4RM fallback design shape. Below the bar: revert.

## Perf evidence

Final A2 comparator on main after refreshing `matmul_row_xor_fallback` leaves:

- Baseline leaf: `matmul_row_xor_fallback/scalar_backend/512x1x8192`.
- New leaf: `matmul_row_xor_fallback/production_mul/512x1x8192`.
- Scalar fallback: 26302.8 ns.
- Dispatched production fallback: 13050.9 ns.
- Geomean: 2.015x, target >= 1.5x, PASS.

Worktree Criterion medians recorded in `dev/benchmarks/jit-5223bb04-mul.txt`:

- `scalar_backend/512x1x8192`: 26.804 us.
- `dispatch_helper/512x1x8192`: 14.033 us.
- `production_mul/512x1x8192`: 12.745 us.
- Production fallback vs scalar fallback: 2.10x.

`perf stat -r 10` captures for the fallback benchmark are recorded in `dev/benchmarks/jit-5223bb04-mul.txt`:

- Scalar fallback comparator: task-clock:u 253.18 msec (+- 0.37%); cycles 1,170,911,703; instructions 1,843,375,406; IPC 1.6; branch-misses 24,885,970; elapsed 0.255080650 +- 0.000954239 s.
- Production dispatched fallback: task-clock:u 254.79 msec (+- 0.39%); cycles 1,168,862,654; instructions 1,841,195,150; IPC 1.6; branch-misses 24,875,774; elapsed 0.256652447 +- 0.000969137 s.
- Note: `--profile-time` runs each selected routine for a fixed profiling duration, so the speed gate is the Criterion median table above; `perf stat` is retained for repeatable counter capture under the same filtered benchmark leaf.

## Notes

Bench: `matmul_row_xor_fallback` in `crates/gf2-core/benches/matmul.rs`. Implementation commit: `dfa42df perf(jit:5223bb04): route row-xor matmul fallback`; comparator commit: `c217269 test(jit:5223bb04): gate fallback row-xor benchmark`. Spec doc: `dev/plans/gf2_core_ppc_spiral.md`.
